entries.name: Current transformer

entries.name: Voltage transformer
entries.summary: A transformer providing a voltage signal for metering or protection.

entries.name: Synchronism check
entries.summary: Checks documented synchronising conditions before a permitted connection.

entries.name: Undervoltage
entries.summary: A function responding to voltage below its configured operating criteria.

entries.name: Directional power
entries.summary: A function responding to power with a specified direction and operating condition.

entries.name: Current unbalance / negative sequence
entries.summary: A current phase-balance or reverse-phase function used in documented protection applications.

entries.name: Thermal protection
entries.summary: A thermal protection function for a documented machine or transformer application.

entries.name: Instantaneous overcurrent
entries.summary: An overcurrent function without an intentional operating time delay in its instantaneous application.

entries.name: Time overcurrent
entries.summary: An overcurrent function with a documented time characteristic.

entries.name: Overvoltage
entries.summary: A function responding to voltage above its configured operating criteria.

entries.name: Directional overcurrent
entries.summary: An overcurrent function with a documented direction criterion.

entries.name: AC autoreclosing
entries.summary: A function coordinating a documented automatic reclosing sequence.

entries.name: Frequency protection
entries.summary: A function responding to a documented frequency condition.

entries.name: Lockout
entries.summary: A lockout function or device with the documented reset and blocking behaviour.

entries.name: Differential protection
entries.summary: A function comparing documented electrical quantities across a protection zone.

entries.name: Master element
entries.summary: Starts or enables the principal operating sequence of a machine or power-system unit.

entries.name: Time-delay starting or closing relay
entries.summary: Introduces a deliberate interval before a starting or closing operation is permitted.

entries.name: Checking or interlocking relay
entries.summary: Checks a required equipment state before the operating sequence proceeds.

entries.name: Master contactor
entries.summary: Switches the main control or operating circuit under the unit's master command.

entries.name: Stopping device
entries.summary: Initiates a machine or unit shutdown by removing the relevant operating permission.

entries.name: Starting circuit breaker
entries.summary: Connects a machine to the electrical supply used during starting.

entries.name: Rate-of-change relay
entries.summary: Responds to how quickly a monitored quantity changes rather than only its absolute magnitude.

entries.name: Control power disconnecting device
entries.summary: Isolates the supply feeding a control circuit or control-power bus.

entries.name: Reversing device
entries.summary: Changes the operating connection to reverse the direction of a machine or power circuit.

entries.name: Unit sequence switch
entries.summary: Selects or determines the order in which multiple units enter an operating sequence.

entries.name: Multifunction device

entries.name: Overspeed device
entries.summary: Responds when machine speed exceeds the documented operating criterion.

entries.name: Synchronous-speed device
entries.summary: Recognises a speed condition associated with synchronism during a machine sequence.

entries.name: Underspeed device
entries.summary: Responds to machine speed below the required operating level.

entries.name: Speed or frequency matching device
entries.summary: Adjusts or supervises the difference between two speed or frequency references.

entries.name: Data communications device
entries.summary: Identifies equipment carrying data between control, protection or monitoring devices.

entries.name: Shunting or discharge switch

entries.name: Accelerating or decelerating device

entries.name: Starting-to-running transition contactor
entries.summary: Changes the machine connection from its starting arrangement to its running arrangement.

entries.name: Electrically operated valve
entries.summary: Commands a valve through an electrical actuator or solenoid.

entries.name: Distance protection

entries.name: Equalizer circuit breaker

entries.name: Temperature control device
entries.summary: Controls heating, cooling or another process action using a temperature input.

entries.name: Overexcitation protection

entries.name: Apparatus thermal device

entries.name: Flame detector

entries.name: Isolating contactor

entries.name: Annunciator relay

entries.name: Undercurrent or underpower protection
